description.value: The Met Hotel is a 27-room heritage boutique hotel occupying an 1892 Victorian-style building in the heart of downtown New Westminster, featuring over-height ceilings, private floor lobbies, and waterfront views in select rooms. The property includes an on-site Taphouse & Kitchen (Howe Sound) and a liquor store, and sits within walking distance of the New Westminster Quay and the Columbia SkyTrain station, putting Downtown Vancouver roughly 30 minutes away.

address.value: 411 Columbia Street, New Westminster, BC V3L 1A9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Met Hotel is an active 27-room heritage boutique hotel in downtown New Westminster with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi (corroborated by OSM internet_access=wlan/fee=no), on-site Taphouse & Kitchen, and vending machines on the second floor. No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere across the five fetched subpages. All contact details — phone, address, and email — match the OSM record exactly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active hotel well-positioned for touring cyclists seeking urban accommodation near the Columbia SkyTrain, but secure bike storage and staff bike procedures are entirely unmentioned on the website, leaving both primary WWC required criteria unconfirmed.
